coordinates: Position variables 7500/7501 (X lo = local, hi = sector) and 7502/7503 (Y) give the world cell at the TOP-LEFT of the 23x29 window buffer F74E. World x grows to the right (east), y grows downwards (south) in the north view. One tile = one 8x8 character cell.

island_record_layout.2,3: local X activation range: island drawn when 2 <= X <= 3 (= data_x0-22 .. data_x1+22)
island_record_layout.4,5: local Y activation range (= data_y0-28 .. data_y1+28)
island_record_layout.6,7: data_x0, data_x1: window fully inside horizontally when data_x0 <= X < data_x1; block col 0 = world x sector*256+data_x0
island_record_layout.8,9: data_y0, data_y1: block row 0 = world y sector*256+data_y0
island_record_layout.10,11: pointer to block (row 0, col 0) inside the 128-byte-stride tile store
island_record_layout.12,13: map-screen bitmap address of the silhouette
island_record_layout.14: silhouette width in pixels (one pixel per 4 tiles)
island_record_layout.15: silhouette height in pixel rows (one per 4 tile rows)
island_record_layout.16,17: map-screen bitmap address of the name
island_record_layout.18: attribute-file high byte for the name (attr = 78h written under each name cell)
